description:
Get Bing Search Results

Fetches Bing SERPs for a query with geo targeting (location/lat/lon), market (mkt), country (cc), safesearch (off/moderate/strict), interface language (setLang), time/custom filters, device type, and pagination (first offset). Returns organic results (title, url, snippet, displayed url, position), related searches, answer boxes/knowledge panels, and pagination metadata. Use for SEO rank tracking, SERP feature monitoring, Bing-specific visibility audits, and training/eval data for search agents.

cc.description: The two-letter country code for the country to search from.

deviceType.description: Specify the device type for the search.

filters.description:
Allows applying various filters to narrow search results, including date-based options:

  - `ex1:"ez1"` – past 24 hours
  - `ex1:"ez2"` – past week
  - `ex1:"ez3"` – past month

For complex filters, run a Bing search and copy the filters parameter from the URL.

first.description: This parameter specifies the number of search results to skip and is used for implementing pagination. For example, a value of 1 (default) indicates the first page of results, 11 refers to the second page, and 21 to the third page.

lat.description: GPS latitude for the search origin.

location.description: Defines the search’s origin location as free text (e.g. `Austin, Texas`). It is resolved to coordinates to localize the results. For realistic results, set location at the city level. If both `lat` and `lon` are provided, they take precedence and `location` is ignored. If omitted, the proxy’s location may be used.

lon.description: GPS longitude for the search origin.

mkt.description: The two-letter country code for the country to search from.

q.description: Specify the search term for which you want to scrape the SERP.

setLang.description: The language of the user interface and preferred result language. Accepts a two-letter language code (e.g. `en`, `de`) or a locale/script variant (e.g. `en-gb`, `zh-hans`, `pt-br`).
